retainedFindings: First11 cases:4 failed/7 passed. Two failures compared freshly allocated NumberValue wrappers by identity; changed to value equality. One guest-throw wrapper comparison failed likewise.
Opaque while condition invokes unsupported concrete Boolean read. The repeated-decision witness now uses a supported if inside a concrete while loop; no loop-protocol extension is claimed.
Initial observer type ValueCompletion includes raw values. Normalize with original EnsureCompletion and expose NormalCompletion<Value>|ThrowCompletion.
Readonly review identified late reentrancy locking through option getters. Lock now covers validation and execution; getter-reentrancy regression passes.
Review caught an unexecuted copying fixture using forbidden numeric host-tree roots. It now returns valid JSON text snapshots.
Intermediate2140-unit run precedes three added policy/cleanup cases. Final2143-unit run follows attached traversal metadata and verifies final code.
limits: Caller supplies synchronous owner and observer. Root discovery, storage policies and transitive execution ownership are not supplied or verified.
Prefix effects occur once before first checkpoint and are not rolled back. No job draining, application loader, event graph, or replay implementation.
Resumes/forks are bounded globally. Concrete execution, native operations, allocation, capture, observers and GC require separate limits; no wall-clock or memory sandbox.
Healthy fork restoration leaves Agent at its first fork; failures release leases but do not promise rollback, universal cleanup or safe Agent reuse.
Primary failures abort sibling exploration, return no partial report, and preserve identity unless aggregated with cleanup errors.
Observer snapshot meaning, guest getter/toJSON effects, completion callbacks and native metadata remain caller responsibilities.
Host-tree content identity is not React state/fiber identity. General React ownership, automatic renderer/report producer, transitions, repeated families and demo remain incomplete.
